op.message:
feat(vault): cached remote vault — read-through encrypted local cache (P-007)

New arca-vault-cached composite impl: [vaults.*] cache = true |
"dev" | ["dev", "staging"] fronts any backend with a
read-through age-encrypted mirror at $XDG_CACHE_HOME/arca/
<vault>.age — the XDG cache dir, disposable-by-convention.

- get/list serve the cache within a TTL (cache_ttl_secs, default
  300s); miss → remote fetch → write-through; rows carry the
  remote version/rotated_at verbatim plus a fetched_at stamp
- writes are always remote-first then update/invalidate the
  mirror — writes never serve stale
- remote failure falls back to the stale copy — the offline mode;
  a corrupt cache file is moved aside (<vault>.corrupt) and
  rebuilt, a corrupt row is a plain miss
- env-scoped policy: dev may cache, prod rows never touch disk —
  unlisted envs pass straight through
- list freshness rides per-env markers in a plaintext
  <vault>.listed.json sidecar (env names + timestamps only);
  remote deletes reconcile into the mirror on the next list

arca-ops wires [vaults.*] cache through open_vault_named (same
identity + recipients as the vault itself) and check flags an
orphaned cache_ttl_secs. Runs the arca-testkit conformance suite
verbatim. Docs: new cached-vaults how-to on the docs branch.
